text_block_list.text:
The Twinkle Series alongside Mejiro Ryan, 
an Umamusume devoted heart and soul to 
training, had officially begun.

Envious of Mejiro McQueen, who boasts some 
of the greatest prowess in the Mejiro 
family, Mejiro Ryan strongly yearns to 
defeat her.

And so, the challenge to take on the 
Twinkle Series together with her began.
